Ethereum Nexus-Reaver is an epic two-handed axe that drops from Doomwalker in Shadowmoon Valley. It can also drop from Doomwalker in Tanaris during WoW's Anniversary.

There are many Ethereum Stasis Chambers located at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains. They can be opened using a Ethereum Stasis Chamber Key. Opening the chamber spawns a random level 70 elite mob. Each mob spawned has a chance to drop Mark of the Nexus-King which is required for The Mark of the Nexus-King. The mobs also have a high chance of dropping the BoP blues listed. Known Mobs spawned * Matron Li-sahar ** Can drop BoP Windchanneller's Mantle (Cloth shoulders with random enchant) * Solus the Eternal ** Can drop BoP Skystalker's Shoulders (Leather shoulders with random enchant) * Gorgolon the All-Seeing ** Can drop BoP Mistshroud Shoulders (Mail shoulders with random enchant) *

Fear Fiends are terrorguards located in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
The Fathomdasher was a ship that was part of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet destroyed by Horde-controlled red dragons in the Second War. Its shipwreck can be found on the sea floor of the Great Sea.
Father's Sword is contained in Pirate Chest on Mechagon Island.
Fel Armor is a warlock ability that increases spell damage and healing.
__NOTOC__ Fel Corrupters are servants of the Burning Legion who can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. Killing them is the objective of Culling the Wild.

The Fel Crystalforges are Crystalforges that can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains at Forge Camp: Wrath and Forge Camp: Terror.

Fel Imp Defenders were fel imps appearing during Shartuul's Transporter event in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Fela is a tauren heavy armor vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, she was trapped by the Void.

The Flame Druid Staff is one of the magical implements used by the Druids of the Flame, currently being stored in the Igneous Depths in the Firelands. The character is tasked to retrieve one for the quest Fandral's Methods.

The Flawless Arcane Essence is one of the objectives of the the quest The Soul Cannon of Reth'hedron, which begins with Illidari Lord Balthas in Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley. To complete this quest, players must speak with Sar'this at Lake Jorune above Stonebreaker Hold in Terokkar Forest and kill the five elementals he summons.
__NOTOC__ Flying Tiger Goggles are cloth head armor that can be used and made by engineers.

Force Reactive Disk is an Engineering-made shield that shocks nearby enemies when the shield blocks. It does about 30-40 points of damage to enemies within 10 yards. Unfortunately the shock can also break crowd control such as polymorph, sap, hibernate, etc. For every block, there's a 50% chance the shield will lose 1 point of durability.
Forge Camp: Anger is the first of three Burning Legion Forge Camps located in the Blade's Edge Mountains. This one can be found south of Bladed Gulch.
Forgotten Armor of Order is an anima power obtained from anima caches in Torghast, Tower of the Damned.

Frost Armor is a passive level 56 Frost mage ability which increases the mage's haste and has a chance to give attackers the Chilled debuff, reducing their movement speed.

Frost Warding is a mage talent that increases the armor and resistance given by the Frost Armor and Ice Armor spells by up to 50% at max rank 2. In addition, it gives Frost Ward and Fire Ward up to 30% chance to negate damage spells that would normally be absorbed (doing no damage to the Ward) and turn the damage they would have caused into mana for the Mage. This talent is useful in both PvP and PvE specs. In PvE it is the most useful talent on its tier after Precision (mage talent) for a non Frost Mage, and is taken by most Arcane mages for the ability to convert raid damage into extra mana. In PvP, it is useful for extra regen and more protection, with half of the classes having some form
Frixee Brasstumbler was a goblin Arena PvP System rewards vendor located at the Circle of Blood in the Blade's Edge Mountains (). The Arena Rewards were bought using arena points.

Frozen Steel Vambraces are plate wrist armor with strength, agility, and stamina.
Frozen Rune Weapon is a Death knight ability that allows the death knight to do extra frost damage on melee attacks.
Furnace Guards are felguard guarding Forge Camp Wrath in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Furywing's Perch is the lair of the black dragon Furywing, who flies over the Crystal Spine and Bash'ir Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Furywing is a black dragon that flies over Bash'ir Landing and the Crystal Spine in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Adventurers should be very careful around Furywing - if she detects anyone she will spit a fireball at them, dealing ~3000 damage.
Gahk is an ogre mage quest giver located at Ogri'la in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Galvanoth is one of the defenders of Forge Camp: Wrath in Blade's Edge Mountains. Galvanoth is one of several demons that can be summoned when you insert 35 Apexis Shards into a Fel Crystal Prism. He hits for 1000 on a properly geared tank, and requires four to five people to kill. Other possible demons that can be summoned are Braxxus, Zarcsin, and Mo'arg Incinerator.
__NOTOC__ Gan'arg Analyzer can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains, researching the Apexis Relics and Apexis Monuments near Ogri'la.

Gallywix's Pride (or the Pride of Gallywix) is the massive cannon mounted on top of Bilgewater Harbor. It is one of the most massive piece of artillery of the world. It points out towards the sea and does not initially appear to be pointed at anything in particular. However, one can find a telescope inside the main facility which is aimed at Stormwind City. During the Fourth War, it was sabotaged by the Alliance, but the Horde repaired it.
The Gale's Reprieve was a ship that was part of the Kul Tiran Third Fleet destroyed by Horde-controlled red dragons in the Second War. Its shipwreck can be found on the sea floor of the Great Sea.
Gan'arg Underling were gan'args appearing during Shartuul's Transporter event in the Blade's Edge Mountains. They can summon Portable Fel Cannons and may heal Mo'arg Tormenters.
Garbs of Royal Ascension are cloth chest armor with stamina and shadow resistance. It also increases spell power, and greatly increases hit chance.
Garloc's Axe would be an objective of Far From Invulnerable.
The Gardener's Hammer is located on a cart in the Garden of Night in Ardenweald. It is used to restore Twinklestar's Gardening Toolkit.

General goods are basic items, usually needed for everyday survival, including basic drinks, food, ranged weapon ammo, and some basic profession or tradeskill tools. Vendors for these items can be found in just about every major city or village. Depending upon the specific vendor, they can sell a variety of items including ammunition, food & drink, wood, bags, simple tools, and minor weapons.

Gor Grimgut is a Bloodmaul ogre who is guarding The Thunderspike in the back of the Draenethyst Mine in the Blade's Edge Mountains. When Horde players on the quest The Thunderspike (quest) try to pick up the Thunderspike, he will spawn and start attacking. Once he is dead, players can take the Thunderspike from his corpse.
Gor'drek is an orc found in Thunderlord Stronghold of Blade's Edge Mountains.
Gorgolon the All-Seeing is a rare spawn observer that can be found at Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains.
Gore-Scythe Ravagers are ravagers found near the Toshley's Station in Blade's Edge Mountains.

Gorelix the Fleshripper is an old and cunning mo'arg who has used the massive axe known as the Maw of the Damned to butcher uprisings and steal the life force of his enemies and replenish his own in the name of the Burning Legion for more than a thousand years. Over its long and infamous history, the weapon has made its demonic bearer extraordinarily powerful. During the events of Legion, Gorelix is confronted and slain on Niskara by a blood death knight seeking to claim the axe for themselves.
Gorgrom's Favor drops for Alliance characters from Dorgok at the Bloodmaul Camp in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Gorgrom the Dragon-Eater is one of the seven sons of Gruul the Dragonkiller and can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. He lives in the top half of one of the houses in Bloodmaul camp, which can be accessed by a ramp. He is behind the recent Bloodmaul ogre's plans against Sylvanaar. As his name says, he slaughtered many black dragons.

Gorribal the Dark Seether is a sword that was forged from one of the two Shatterbound fragments of Gorshalach. Wielded by Sargeras, this weapon embodies the darkness that exists in all beings, even noble ones. If this weapon is ever combined with the other fragment, which has been reforged into Taeshalach, then Gorshalach will be reborn, although this can only be done by a non-evil being.
Gorr'Dim is an ogre mage found in Bladespire Hold in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Gorr'Dim is one of several leaders of the Bladespire clan.
Grand Marshal's Right Hand Blade is a fist weapon that can be purchased inside the Champion's Hall in Stormwind City. __NOTOC__
is a fist weapon that can be purchased inside the Champion's Hall in Stormwind City. __NOTOC__
Grand Marshal's Aegis is a shield with a large amount of stamina and strength.

Graw Cornerstone is a dwarf armor vendor located in a small camp just northeast of the Blackrock Mountain entrance in the Searing Gorge. He has been missing since the Cataclysm. It seems likely given his precarious position that he was killed by the encroaching Dark Irons that now populate his camp.

Grod is a tauren leather armor vendor located on the middle rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.

Gruul's Lair is located north of Ruuan Weald in the Blade's Edge Mountains of Outland. Here, Gruul the Dragonkiller, the merciless gronn overlord, rules over the ogres of Blade's Edge. This raid contains two bosses, Gruul the Dragonkiller and , and requires no attunement. The player must be at least level 65 and in a raid to enter.
Grunt Grahk is an orc quest giver located at Blades' Run in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Grulloc's Dragon Skull drops from Grulloc in Blade's Edge Mountains.

The Guardian's Staff is provided by Matoclaw to summon and defeat Galenges for The Power of Malorne.

Guardian of the Forgotten Queen is a Protection paladin PvP talent, available at Level 40, replacing Guardian of Ancient Kings with a new ability which renders the paladin immune to all damage for 10 seconds, serving as a second Divine Shield for most intents and purposes.
__NOTOC__ Gurn Grubnosh can be found in Blade's Edge Mountains. He appears when a Bladespire Clan Banner is planted on top of the Northmaul Tower.
Gyro-balanced Khorium Destroyer is an epic gun made by Engineers. It is designed mostly for protection Warriors.

The Hammer of the Grand Crusader is a two-handed mace wielded by Balnazzar when he disguised himself as Saidan Dathrohan. It is a dangerous weapon when placed in the wrong hands, and sometimes the right ones. It helps to improve the Haste, Strength and Stamina of its wielder.
Hammer of Judgement is an epic one-handed mace for shadow priests, protection paladins, elemental shamans and moonkin druids.

The Hammer's Cradle is a large chamber in the center of the upper level of Thunder Totem in Highmountain. Ernu Mesawind is the innkeeper here. After Moozy's Sojourn, the Waterwise family reunites here, and after Moozy's Reunion they are joined by Ethel Waterwise.
Hammer Punks are dwarves located at the Western Spray on Mechagon Island.
__NOTOC__ Hammer Outcasts are void elves and worgen located at the Western Spray on Mechagon Island.

The Hammer of Shattered Works drops from the Corrupted Architect at the Circle of Thought in Zereth Mortis.

Hank the Hammer is a human quest giver located in the Dwarven District in the human capital of Stormwind City. He is affiliated with the Mithril Order. He currently keeps a lookout for Alliance blacksmiths that might want to join the Mithril Order and become an armorsmith. If the blacksmith does want to join, he first tests their skills by having them make several Golden Scale Bracers. If they are successful in that test, he sends the blacksmith to McGavan in Booty Bay.
Harbinger's Pendant drops from Harbinger of the Raven in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Harbinger of the Raven is an arakkoa summoned in Veil Ruuan in the Blade's Edge Mountains, using 6 Ruuan'ok Claws at the Ruaan'ok Oracle Circle.

Hewa is a tauren cloth armor vendor located in Hewa's Armory on the lower rise in Thunder Bluff. During the feast for the Highmountain tauren, he was trapped by the Void.
Heroic Throw is a level 10 warrior ability that flings their main hand weapon at an opponent, dealing damage.

High King Maulgar is the ogre lord of the ogres at the Blade's Edge Mountains in Outland, ruling from within Gruul's Lair. His council consists of Kiggler the Crazed, Blindeye the Seer, Olm the Summoner, and Krosh Firehand.
Highmountain Hammer is a world drop from Outland elite mobs.

The Hired Courier is an orc or human found dead aboard a ship docked near the city they were headed to with a special delivery. The orc courier was killed by Maxim the Sly, while the human courier was killed by Ren Quickhand.
Honest Blades is a weapon shop found in the Old Town in Stormwind City.
Holy Sword is an ability used by Mini Tyrael during a Pet Battle.
Hoodoo Hex is used on leg and head armor to permanently increase stamina, and spell power.

Horn Fragments are actually pieces of Hodir's Horn, which was shattered when Thorim threw his hammer, Krolmir to the earth, creating the Thunderfall. The character is tasked to collect these pieces from around the Thunderfall during the quest In Memoriam (quest).

Horace Hunderland is a human plate armor vendor found in the Magus Commerce Exchange of Dalaran. During the purge of Dalaran, he was in a fighting stance. He was present in the city when it appeared above Deadwind Pass. He is not present when Dalaran is above the Broken Isles.

Houndmaster's Rifle is a Level 47 quality Gun that improves Agility and Stamina. It has an Equip effect that improves your Attack Power when fighting beasts. This gun is a parallel of the Houndmaster's Bow.
Houndmaster's Bow is a quality Bow that improves Agility and Stamina. It has an Equip effect that improves your Attack Power when fighting beasts. This bow is a parallel of the Houndmaster's Rifle.

Huey is the gryphon mount of Grif Wildheart that he and hunter adventurer use to travel to island of Shield's Rest in Stormheim and later to return to Dalaran during their search for Titanstrike. During the Fourth War, Huey also appeared at the Inventor's Library in the Storm Peaks during the search for Hati. A pair of Library Guardians was uneasy because of Huey. After absorbing the essences of Hati, Huey flew Grif to Ulduar.
Husk of Nerub'enkan is a Level 48 quality Shield that improves Strength, Stamina and Parry.
The Hydralick Armor is a plate chestguard that gives a bonus to strength, stamina, agility, and fire resistance.
Hypnotic Dust can be created from disenchanting, primarily from armor in Cataclysm. These are also sold by the following vendors: * in Orgrimmar for * in Stormwind City for
Ice Barbed Spear is a two-handed polearm. It gives a bonus to strength, agility, and stamina. It has a natural blue icy weapon glow.

__NOTOC__ Icy Scale Bracers are Leatherworking-made mail wrist armor that give a bonus to stamina, attack power and frost resistance. The recipe to make this can no longer be learned. The Frozen Rune material component is also no longer available.

Illyanie is a night elf cloth armor vendor located at Stonetalon Peak in the Stonetalon Mountains. She's been missing since the Cataclysm, most likely having been killed in the faceless one attack on the Stonetalon Peak camp.

Image of Commander Ameer is an ethereal quest giver that can be summoned at locations in two zones: Ethereum Staging Grounds in Netherstorm and Bash'ir Landing in Blade's Edge Mountains. The initial quest in the chain is started with his physical self in Netherstorm.
Illidari Lord Balthas' Instructions are provided for The Soul Cannon of Reth'hedron which begins with Illidari Lord Balthas in Dragonmaw Base Camp in Shadowmoon Valley.
Imbued Unstable Diamond can be purchased for from Aether-tech Master in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Image of Archmage Aethas Sunreaver can be found at Agmar's Hammer in the Dragonblight. He has projected his image to Agmar's Hammer from Dalaran to address the rising threat of the Blue dragonflight.
The Imperial Plate is an 7-piece armor set with heavy stamina and strength bonuses, crafted by Blacksmithing. During the World of Warcraft alpha, the armor set was intended to equip human footmen.
Improved Shield Block extends the Shield Block ability to block attacks, reducing the total damage taken by the Warrior.
Increases the duration of the Warrior's Shield Wall ability by a small amount.
Improved Weapon Totems increased the melee attack power bonus of Windfury Totem and increased the damage caused by Flametongue Totem.
Improved Sunder Armor reduces the Rage cost of the Sunder Armor ability.

Indestrucible armor and weapons do not take durability damage in any form. One of the rare minor attributes, any Warlords-level gear looted or crafted has a slim chance of spawning with one bonus minor attribute.
Indestructible Armor Set was rewarded through Class Hall missions and work orders, and contained in Emissary caches.

__NOTOC__ Infazzar the Shade is a nathrezim located on his legion ship above Rhut'van Peak in Azsuna. After infiltrating the Shrine of Aviana in disguise as the druid Skylord Shadegrove, he stole the Idol of Aviana allowing druids to assume their flight form. He headed to Rhut'van Peak in Azsuna and used the idol to corrupt the Cragtalon harpies there in order to use them to assault Dalaran, but was slain aboard his ship by Thisalee Crow and the Archdruid of the Dreamgrove.

Inflatable Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker was found inside Anniversary Gift (old) during WoW's 11th Anniversary. During WoW's 12th Anniversary, it could be purchased from in Stormwind City or in Orgrimmar at a cost of . When used, it equips the player who uses it with a replica of the infamous Thunderfury, Blessed Blade of the Windseeker. It also rewards the achievement Did Someone Say...? the first time it is used.
Inner Fire is a free instant Priest self-buff that increases the priest's armor gained from items by 60%, and increases spell power by 10%. Lasts until cancelled.
__NOTOC__ Innkeeper Shaunessy is a night elf innkeeper located in Sylvanaar in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
Innkeeper Aelerya is a night elf innkeeper located at Evergrove in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

__NOTOC__ Insidion is a black dragon that flies over Bash'ir Landing and the Crystal Spine in the Blade's Edge Mountains. Be very careful around Insidion - if he detects you he will spit a fireball at you. (~3000 damage)
Insidion's Perch is the lair of the black dragon Insidion, who flies over the Crystal Spine and Bash'ir Landing in the Blade's Edge Mountains.

Inquisitor Salrand is floating in a force shield above Beryl Point in the Borean Tundra. Players can use the Beryl Shield Detonator to knock her out of her shield and kill her in order to loot her key from her chest while on A Race Against Time. She is leading the beryl mage hunters with the clear purpose to capture the spell-casters for the Aspect of Magic, Malygos. She appears to be extremely determinated in her work.
Insidious Familiars were level 70 - 71 imps that used to spawn at Felstorm Point in Blade's Edge Mountains. They were removed in patch 2.1.0 when that subzone was removed.

Innovating the Engine concludes the "The Spark of Ingenuity" quest chain to acquire additional to create additional , a very powerful reagent used to craft end-game armor and weapons. This quest chain was originally on a one or two-week time-gate, but now can be completed without any forced waiting.
Ion Cannon is an ability used by various pets during a Pet Battle.
The Iridescent Hammer is a one-handed mace with a bonus to strength and stamina.

The iron fish is a single-person vehicle that holds enough air to allow for one hour of underwater travel. On several occasions, pilots have taken advantage of its powerful engine and thick metal hull to ram — and even sink — other vessels. It moves at 60 miles per hour.
__NOTOC__ Ironstar's Petrified Shield is a common dwarf archaeology artifact that requires 36 Dwarf Archaeology Fragments to solve, allowing one keystone to be used.
Ironforge Riflemen are dwarves located in Stormwind City during The Unseen Blade.

Item upgrading provides players the ability to upgrade item levels of equippable items, such as armor, weapons, and trinkets above from specific Mists of Pandaria and Warlords of Draenor sources. Players can upgrade items by spending appropriate currencies at any item upgrader NPC. As stats on items are based upon the item's level, upgrading an item's level will upgrade its stats as well.
The Jade Serpentblade has a jade gem inset in the hilt and a cruel hook in the blade. It gives a bonus to strength and agility.
Jagged Mossjewel can be purchased for from Aether-tech Adept in the Blade's Edge Mountains.
__NOTOC__ Janna Brightmoon is a night elf cloth armor vendor located in Aldrassil in Teldrassil. It is unknown whether she survived the Burning of Teldrassil or not.
